title: github.repository.get v1 arguments
description: EffectDescriptor.arguments for effect_type github.repository.get (HELM-753), a read. The target is github.com/{owner}/{repo}; the repository comes only from the target. The result gives the default branch and its head commit, and the requested branch's head when one is named, so a later github.branch.create_from_changes attempt takes base and base_sha from a gateway read instead of from Zone B. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, and the gateway enforces before admission: no duplicate object keys; UTF-8 only; the whole document is at most 4096 bytes; branch passes git check-ref-format.

branch.description: A branch whose head to read as well.

x-helm.observable: yes: the read is the observation
